features.title: Research
features.summary: A brief becomes a sourced, verified, approved script on the local model, with three gates where a person decides.
how: planSearch writes one query per claim and shows the strategy before anything runs
the research service on :25100 hunts through searxng, a reader, yt-dlp and gh
the critic keeps, doubts or rejects every source with a reason; you review
gather, write, verify line by line against passages, revise once, judge coverage
the pipeline stops at approval; the reel is built from the approved script

features.title: Plugins and the GPU
features.summary: Every service the studio renders through is a card with health checks and a Start button; the lipsync provider hands the GPU to ComfyUI before it posts a job; everything the plugins do lands on screen.
how: lib/plugins/registry.ts lists each service, its health URL and its start recipe
yieldGpuToComfy unloads whatever research-ollama holds with keep_alive 0
a ring log of 200 lines feeds notifications everywhere and the Plugins page
health flips are announced only after two consecutive polls

features.title: Jobs
features.summary: The Jobs tab: the research pool pulled into a ledger, cuts prepared and submitted to the jobs-reel board, and the board's weeks listed underneath.
how: GET /api/jobs/weeks proxies the board's week list, server side
summarise and plan post through POST /api/jobs/weeks/{week}/run
voice, render and export stay in npm run weekly in a terminal

features.title: Jobs bridge
features.summary: Research-plugin's job pool becomes weekly or daily cuts in the jobs-reel schema, submitted to its board, with every pull, row, cut and reply kept in SQLite.
how: Pull now pages GET /api/jobs?category=india&tech=0&group=1 from research-plugin into jobs_pool and diffs it against the last pull
Prepare maps each posting to the reel's row: function by rule table then one qwen call, experience bands, work mode, INR salary, one name per city
the reel's own summarise arithmetic computes the tiles before anything is sent; under 20 rows is thin
Submit posts jobs.json and brief.md to POST /api/weeks/{key}/jobs on the board, then summarise and plan; a period with an export needs force
every reply is a submissions row; the cut's status follows the board; a Cut node in Neo4j links the week to the pull it came from

features.title: Knowledge stores
features.summary: Neo4j holds one graph with a space per category; Qdrant holds passages and verified claims. Both live on D:, both are derived from data/ and rebuilt with one command.
how: docker/compose.yml: iolar-neo4j on 3124/3125, iolar-qdrant on 3126/3127, volumes under D:\iolar
lib/knowledge/neo4j.ts and qdrant.ts implement one GraphStore and one VectorStore interface
lib/knowledge/fake.ts is the in-memory twin every test runs against
npm run reindex:knowledge -- --wipe replays handbooks, reels and the jobs board

features.title: Knowledge spaces
features.summary: Handbooks, reels and jobs each write their own space through lib/knowledge; topics, sources, domains and claims are shared between them.
how: handbooks: Subject, Chapter, COVERS Topic, SHARES_TOPIC between chapters
reels: Reel ABOUT Topic, MUST_PROVE Claim, HUNTED/KEPT/REJECTED Source, ScriptLine CITES and PROVES, Claim SUPPORTED_BY Source with the passage
jobs: Week LISTS Employer, IN Function and City, MODE, HIGHLIGHT Topic
every writer is a MERGE and never fails its caller

features.title: Knowledge graph page
features.summary: One page, four tabs: Handbooks, Reels, Jobs, All. Cytoscape draws the 400 most connected nodes; a search by meaning shows what the agents would see.
how: GET /api/graph?space= runs one Cypher per space, capped, most connected first
?ask= embeds the question and searches the space's Qdrant collections
All shows nodes whose neighbours span more than one space

features.title: Agent memory
features.summary: The four research agents read the stores before they act: domains that worked, verdicts on pages seen before, claims already proven with their passage, and the nearest passages for each line.
how: lib/knowledge/recall.ts turns Cypher and vector queries into capped text blocks
each agent prompt takes a MEMORY block ahead of its shape contract
the graph nodes recall when knowledgeMemory is on and write what they remembered to the trace
the Claude path and knowledgeMemory: false get no memory and run as before

features.title: How it works
features.summary: This page: one card per feature from docs/implementation.json, with its status, how it works, files and tests. The full handbook lives in docs/handbooks/.
how: GET /api/about serves the manifest
every task that lands a feature flips its entry here in the same commit

features.title: Audio: slides cut to the voice; the studio submits the list and the recordings
features.summary: The jobs-reel plugin cuts every slide to the line spoken over it (0.25 s lead, the line, 0.6 s pad, floored per role, on the frame grid) and the reel is the sum of its slides, 35 to 75 s. Scenes animate on progress so they complete inside shorter beats. The studio's job is the data and the voice: it submits the list, plans in a chosen style, lets the plugin write the lines, records them with kokoro or piper, posts the recordings, and starts the build. The Jobs tab has a Request formats tab that shows, per style, the beats and the exact JSON the plugin expects, straight from the plugin's own catalogue.
how: submit = POST /api/weeks/{w}/jobs, run summarise, run plan {style}, run script (plugin's writer), GET /api/weeks/{w}/script, studio speak() per line, POST /api/weeks/{w}/script {style, lines[{beatId, text, audio{mp3 base64}}]}, run build (detached, GET /api/weeks/{w}/build for the log)

the plugin measures every recording with ffprobe, fits the timeline (lib/voice/fit.ts), lays the lines with adelay, and renders; captions are spelled from the script, timed by whisper, never straddle a cut, and sit above each world's punchlines
the urgency beat tries deadline-pressure then fresh-posts (posted in the last 2/7 days); fallbacks resolve through the world and never reuse a scene; classic draws cities with stat-cities
GET /api/styles is the per-style request catalogue; GET /api/weeks/{w}/request?style= is the concrete template with beat ids, budgets and what each slide shows
settings.jobsStyle and jobsVoice ('studio' | 'plugin') pick the pack and who records; a cut's status runs submitted, summarised, planned, scripted, voiced, building
music is off (plugin settings.music.enabled false); when it returns it plays only in the gaps between lines
